chat.t: Do you happen to know this fable?
The Sun and the Wind made a bet to see who could strip a traveler of their clothes.
When the wind blew hard, the traveler wrapped their clothes tighter,
and when the sun grew hotter, the traveler took off their clothes.

o: I know that one.
Why the sudden mention of fables?

chat.t: I think that fable is complete nonsense.
Think about it.
If a gale had completely ripped their clothes apart and blown them away, wouldn't the wind have won?

o: Indeed, that makes sense.

chat.t: Right? I knew you'd answer like that.
Now, here's the real point.
Don't you want to see clothes getting ripped apart and blown away by the wind?

o: Of course!
Definitely!

chat.t: Then let's meet at Vermont Plaza.
Still, didn't it feel good?
It sends shivers down your spine when the wind blows right between your legs.
Ah, this refreshing pleasure!

o: It just chilled me to the bone.

chat.t: So you liked it that much, huh?

o: Not even close!

lines.t: Vermont Plaza
What's the rush? Why did you run all the way here...?
Hurry!!!
Blow all the clothes away!!
You must have been really looking forward to this.
Well, obviously! Getting to witness such a precious experience!
Really? Then are you mentally prepared?
I was ready even before I got your message.
More importantly, aren't you dragging this out too much? Don't tell me you're backing out now.
What? Are you doubting me?
There are just so many scammers in this world.
True, it is hard to believe until you see it with your own eyes.
Here we go, then!
Alright!
O Wind... blow everything away!
Wh-Where is this wind coming from...!
Oh no, my clothes are going to fly away!!
And just like that, my clothes were completely ripped and blown away.
Huh...?
That person's clothes... Oh dear...
Oh gosh... They must have been wearing incredibly worn-out clothes...
Wow, that was a success.
How does it feel to get what you wanted?
What on earth did you do!
What do you mean, "what did I do"?
Now you can naturally enjoy some outdoor exhibitionism play, right?
Everyone just feels sorry for you, so I doubt anyone will report you.
So, enjoy this moment!
I don't have that kind of hobby!
Huh? What are you talking about?
Didn't you get locked up in the Panoticon for running around naked?
That might have been the charge, but it was all a misunderstanding!
Oh... Really?
I misunderstood too. I got excited thinking I'd found a kindred spirit...
Huh? A kindred spirit?
Well, since it's already come to this, let's feel the wind together!
Who knows? You might open your eyes to a new hobby.
O Wind... blow everything away!
Th-That person's clothes too...
We should be careful too... The wind today is really strange...
Ahhh... The wind feels so good!
Wow... That is a truly magnificent view...
...Is what I'd like to say, but we can't keep staying like this.
I'm heading back.
You're going back like that? What about your clothes?
Do you think I have any! I'm going back because I don't!
Ahaha, then there's no need to worry.
O Wind... return!
Huh? Isn't this the outfit I was wearing...?
Yep! I should return what belongs to you.
It feels even worse because you returned it as a pile of rags!!
You should have used magic to steal that person's clothes instead!
I can't do something so shameful.
You literally blew my clothes away!
Blowing them away is different from stealing!
Then blow their clothes away! I'll pick them up! That's not stealing!

After bickering for a while like that,
I threw my tattered rags of an outfit back on and returned to the Hideout.

chat.t: Should I tell you about a great spot?

o: What is it this time?

chat.t: A great place to strip, of course.

o: I figured as much.

chat.t: I knew we were on the same page.

o: In what way?

chat.t: You're coming, right?

o: Why should I?
I'm not going.

chat.t: Oh? That's too bad.
Guess I'll have to strip by myself then.

o: On my way. Drop the location right now.

chat.t: So sudden?

o: Just so you know, I have no intention of stripping in front of people.

chat.t: Well, alright! Then come here.
Emily shared a location.
That was a thrill-filled day.

o: A bit too much of a thrill...
Thanks to you, my clothes turned to rags again.

chat.t: That's actually a good thing.
Let's enjoy more of that thrilling feeling together.

o: I should start charging you money every time we meet.
Since I'm running out of clothes.

chat.t: So you're not refusing to meet up.
I knew we were on the same page.
My eyes didn't deceive me.
You and I are the same breed.

o: Not at all! I said we're not!!

chat.t: A strong denial is a strong affirmation!

lines.t: Vermont Dead End
Ugh, what took you so long?
I ran all the way here... By the way, you haven't stripped yet?
You never know.
Maybe you changed your mind and wanted to strip too.
It's better if we strip together, so I waited!
...I can relate to that on some level, but somehow it's hard to agree right now.
Really? Then let's strip together. Naked bonding is true bonding!
I was talking about something other than outdoor exhibitionism... You really have a confusing way of putting things.
Anyway, what kind of place is this?
Ah, here? It's the first place I ever stripped. The wind gathers here in such a refreshing way!
Ever since then, whenever my mind is cluttered or I'm having a hard time, I come here to enjoy it!
...Well, you're still stripping either way.
Last time, I couldn't see anything because of a certain someone causing a scene. Today, I'm going to fully feast my eyes.
So hurry up!
Hmm, well, if you're looking forward to it that much...
Ah, this is the life!
Feeling the wind with your whole body is truly the best!!
Nice, very nice!
This is exactly what I wanted!
What a lovely sight.
We were hoping for something like this too.
What? Did you guys come here to strip too?
No, we...
came to apprehend you!
Committing such scandalous acts in our territory...
Let's have a deep conversation in the Confessional.
I'm getting a really bad feeling about this.
Just a few days ago, people like that never came here.
Guess that's it for today...
Why are you disappointed!
We need to run away first!
Don't worry, I have a plan.
First, hold onto me tight.
Huh?
Hold where?
Anywhere.
If you say so...
Grab her chest.
Grab her butt.
Ah...
It feels nice, warm, and squishy.
Oh...
Why did you have to grab there of all places!
Well, it was sticking out, so it was easy to grab.
Whew... Alright, let's go!
That's a dead end, though.
It would be easier for you to just give up.
Fools. The wind roams wherever it pleases!
O Wind, swirl and rage!
Whoaaaaa!
I floated up into the air with Emily.
The wind is licking my entire body so vividly... This is absolutely the best!
At this point, it's not licking, it's literally biting us!!
Afterward, we safely landed in an empty lot and ran away.

chat.t: Have you seen this week's trending video?

o: What is it?

chat.t: Check this out.

o: People whose clothes were torn by a gale?
Wait, is this by any chance you and me?

chat.t: Duh, obviously.

o: We need to meet right now!

chat.t: Did you make it back okay?

o: No, I didn't.
I'm not an exhibitionist maniac like you!!

chat.t: Aw, stop, you're flattering me!

o: Flattering, my foot!

chat.t: Hit me up anytime you feel like stripping down.
I know all the best spots with a nice breeze.

o: That is never going to happen!

lines.t: Vermont Plaza
You're here! Did you finally get the urge?
Y-You... You!!! What do you mean 'you're here'?!
I became a laughingstock on the internet because of you!
How was I supposed to know a famous influencer would be filming there of all days?
But at least you were blurred out, right?
Only my face!
No one can recognize you just from that.
That would be true for an ordinary person.
However, we are no ordinary people.
We can recognize someone solely by their body shape.
Oh great, they're here again!
They didn't just show up. They've been waiting.
Huh?
I thought about it long and hard, and running away is bad for my reputation.
You called me out here for a stupid reason like that?!
Well, are you just going to run away every single time we meet?
Well... I guess I can't run away forever.
Then obviously, we should round them up nicely and take them all out at once.
Are you planning on taking all of us on by yourself?
Of course.
Ngh... To think you're trying to strip us of our clothes again...
It really fires me up!
What are you talking about? I'm the one who's trying to strip.
You guys aren't the only ones fired up, you know.
I'll show you how serious I am, so...
Watch out so you don't get blown away!
Aaaaargh!!!
Whew... that's the last of them.
You blew them all away...
If I can rip clothes, why wouldn't I be able to blow people away?
But why did only our clothes blow away again?
Hmm, I don't know. Maybe nun habits have divine protection?
The wind is dressing you instead!!
If I focus, I can even do needlework.
Then why is someone like that so obsessed with stripping?
Because I want to feel the wind with my whole body.
Clothes just get in the way of the wind directly touching my skin.
If you strip down, feel the wind, and enjoy freedom, you'll understand what I mean.
No, I really don't get it...
That's just because you haven't properly tried it yet!
You're saying that to someone who literally got arrested, so you're not very convincing, you know?
That's a shame. I thought you and I would speak the same language.
You just don't know what you truly want yet!
I told you, that's not it!
They say a strong denial is a strong affirmation, right?
Well, bye! Let's strip together again next time!
...Wow, she really only says what she wants to say.
Just how free is her mind?
